content: MK reads Gāzurgāhī's inclusion of Qāżīzāda Rūmī among Akhlāṭī's disciples as corroborating a warm relationship between the astronomer and Ṣāʾin al-Dīn, 'undoubtedly' dating to the period they studied together in Samarkand under Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's elder brother Ṣadr al-Dīn (citing Eichner, EI3, and Ragep, EI2).
refers_to_primary: MK on Gāzurgāhī's inclusion of Qāżīzāda Rūmī
